notes:
Lead source: PLG signup (self-serve) via referral link — registered org 2026-02-18. No AE outreach yet; inbound flagged to SDR queue.

Summary:
- Micro-startup (founder-led), 3 devs, building a lightweight code-review + assistant plugin for VS Code and GitHub PRs.
- Primary intent: hosted_api for fast prototyping and beta testers; likely to upgrade to paid credits if latency + cost look good.
- Workloads: interactive code assistant (low latency ~200-400ms per token desirable), embeddings for semantic search across repos, reranking for suggestion scoring.
- Model preferences: prefers smaller open models (Llama-family or Mistral variants) to control cost; wants option to fallback to larger models for complex queries.

Timeline / activities:
- 2026-02-18: Org signup (email: lucas@snapdove.dev) — created test API key.
- 2026-02-20: First test calls — dev notes: "responses look fine but token burn higher than expected on long diffs".
- 2026-02-24: Email thread started re: rate limits — linked thread-f0a3c9b2.
- 2026-02-25: Short recorded demo (Fireflies ff_20260225_01_yd9e3) with founder Lucas; demo ~18min. Quote: "Need something predictable — can't surprise beta users with a $500 bill in a week."
- 2026-03-02: Small POC run with 5K tokens/day for embedding + chat; preliminary results: median latency 320ms, 95th 740ms on hosted plan.
- 2026-03-08: Opened support ticket RDW-4321 about per-minute rate guidance; support replied with best-practice doc (drive:/decks/snapdove/redwood_pricing_v1.pdf).
- 2026-03-10: Internal note: seeded with sample prompts and saw cost at ~$1.2 per 1k tokens with selected model; founder asking for concrete per-month estimate for 10k daily users (estimating ~1M tokens/day).

Requirements & priorities (founder language / paraphrased):
- "Public cloud is fine — we don't handle PHI or regulated data."
- SSO not required for now; SOC 2 is on roadmap for next 12 months.
- Data residency: prefer US-only, but not strict for beta.
- Observability: wants token-level cost breakdown and per-route latency metrics to show to investors.
- Failover: wants simple routing/fallback to lower-cost model variant if we hit capacity.

Technical constraints / target SLOs:
- Latency target: p50 < 300ms for typical code-completion lengths; p95 < 800ms acceptable during beta.
- Throughput: low bursts (10-20 rps) during days, occasional spikes up to 200 rps during launches.
- Cost sensitivity: high — budget-constrained. Estimated ARR potential small initially; may convert to monthly committed seat later.

Next steps (suggested by SDR/SE):
- SDR to send short note with cost calculator link + recommended model/quantization profiles.
- SE (Alex Rivera) to prepare a one-pager with example token burn scenarios (10k, 100k, 1M tokens/day) and sample routing config for fallback.
- Offer a short free credits top-up (one-off) to stress-test spikes and observe real-world latency and cost.

Open questions / blockers:
- Need clear estimate for 1M tokens/day on hosted_api using recommended model (founder wants within 48h).
- Clarify rate-limits and soft quota bump process during product launches.

Other misc CRM notes:
- Founder: Lucas Chen (CTO/founder) — prefers async comms (email).
- Tone: pragmatic, DIY-first, values transparent pricing and no-surprises.
- Potential upsell path: hosted_api -> monthly credits -> Dedicated if high throughput and data isolation required (6-12mo timeline).
